name: Network Bandwidth
description: The available network bandwidth can significantly impact the analysis time. If the network is congested, it may take longer to fetch and process market data.

name: Server Load
description: A high server load can lead to slower analysis times, especially if the server is struggling to handle multiple requests simultaneously.

name: Database Query Time
description: Slow database query times can also contribute to longer analysis times, especially if the database is heavily loaded or the queries are complex.

name: Data Volume
description: A large volume of market data can increase the time it takes to fetch and process the data, leading to multimodal behavior.

name: Data Complexity
description: Complex market data can be more time-consuming to analyze, leading to multimodal behavior.

name: Trader Experience
description: Less experienced traders may require more time to analyze market data, leading to multimodal behavior.

name: Analysis Mode
description: The choice of analysis mode (technical or fundamental) can also impact the analysis time, with technical analysis potentially being faster.

name: Analysis Algorithm
description: Different analysis algorithms can have varying execution times, leading to multimodal behavior.

name: Trader Training
description: Traders with more training may be more efficient in their analysis, leading to multimodal behavior.

name: Time of Day
description: The time of day can impact the analysis time, with certain times of day being busier or more volatile.

name: Market Volatility
description: Higher market volatility can increase the time it takes to analyze market data, leading to multimodal behavior.

name: System Updates
description: System updates or maintenance can impact the analysis time, leading to multimodal behavior.

name: Human Error
description: Human error, such as incorrect data entry or analysis, can lead to longer analysis times, contributing to multimodal behavior.

name: Software Bugs
description: Software bugs or glitches can also impact the analysis time, leading to multimodal behavior.

name: Environmental Factors
description: Environmental factors, such as power outages or natural disasters, can impact the analysis time, leading to multimodal behavior.
